notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds (including School Nutrition) are governmental funds, so business_type is null. Basic statements: Exhibit A (p1 net position, used for balance_sheet), Exhibit B (p2 activities), p3 balance sheet, p4 fund statement by fund, p5 Exhibit D total governmental funds column (used for receipts/disbursements). Beginning cash is the printed total beginning fund balance 6,427,252.57 (p5). Receipts exclude 20,000,000 bond proceeds (debt_proceeds); printed total receipts 33,076,959.20 includes it. Identity: 6,427,252.57 + 13,076,959.20 - 12,832,455.77 + 20,000,000 = 26,671,756.00. Total column nets inter-fund transfers (249,000) to zero via the Reclassifications column, so top-level transfers are null. Combined 'Other' taxes (2,981,755.85) split using General Fund budget schedule (p8) and Special Building schedule (p16); sums to the printed line. 'Miscellaneous local receipts' 669,884.34 split into General Fund other local receipts, Special Building misc, nutrition sales, nutrition misc, and activities/student fee receipts (activities less an inferred 9,000 transfer). 'Other student support' 865,068.08 split into School Nutrition (482,624.70) and Activities (382,443.38) disbursements. Transfer cross-check: Depreciation Fund 'Transfer from general fund' 50,000 (p12) is hidden inside General Fund 2710 Vehicle operation/Student transportation - regular (Exhibit F reclassification p7); recorded as other financing -50,000 in detail with the 2710 expenditure reduced to 391,199.64. School Nutrition 'Allocation from general fund' 240,000 (p15) and inferred 9,000 inside Activities receipts together equal the General Fund 8000 Transfers 249,000 (p11); both recorded as other financing. Detail double counting avoided: General Fund disbursements use Exhibit N program-by-object lines (pp18-19) for programs 1100-2162; the trimmed PDF stops partway through Exhibit N (after 2162 Occupational therapy ages 3-5), so remaining programs (2163 onward) come from the Exhibit G budget schedule as 'not itemized' (budget_final only on those lines). Exhibit E (pp6-7, General Fund components) not recorded in detail; it is covered by Exhibit G (General Fund column), H (Depreciation) and I (Employee Benefit). Student Fee Fund and Depreciation Fund have no disbursements. Zero-actual budget-only lines (2143, 2214, 6412, 6996) omitted. Exhibit N 'Other Purchased Services' mapped to professional/contract services, 'Purchased Property Services' to repairs and maintenance, 'Other Expenses' to miscellaneous expenditure (review). Read pages 1-19 of 19. 'Capital projects' 907,067.62 (p5) split using the Special Building Fund schedule (p16): building project costs 543,950.92 (capital outlay) and bond issuance costs 363,116.70 (debt service interest, fees), consistent with detail.
